label: Launching the first wave
subgoals: Divide the source voltage between its resistance and Z0
Compute the load and source reflection coefficients
Hold the source end at the launched value until two delays pass

label: Tracking successive reflections
subgoals: List the arrival times at the load as odd multiples of the delay
Add one plus gamma L times each incident wave
Shrink each incident wave by the round-trip product of gammas

label: The voltage at the source end
section: The voltage at the source end
subgoals: Mark the source-end events at even multiples of the delay
Add the returning load reflection to the launched wave
Add its re-reflection from the source with gamma S
